title: Trimble Lowers Barrier to Entry for 3D Grade Control with New Trimble Earthworks Configuration
summary: New dual DA2 GNSS receiver configuration for Trimble Earthworks provides simplified, competitively-priced grade control solution with the precision, dependability and uptime for which Trimble is known
body_markdown:
New dual DA2 GNSS receiver configuration for Trimble Earthworks provides simplified, competitively-priced grade control solution with the precision, dependability and uptime for which Trimble is known


WESTMINSTER, Colo


., Oct. 20, 2026


—


Trimble today announced a new configuration of the Trimble


Ⓡ


Earthworks grade control platform for excavators, utilizing dual DA2 GNSS receivers. Designed specifically to meet the needs of cost-sensitive customers, this new offering significantly lowers the barrier to entry for machine control technology while providing a 3D positioning solution that helps operators work more efficiently and with high accuracy.


The DA2 GNSS receiver adds yet another option to Trimble’s extensive portfolio of on-machine technology, with multiple options available to meet the needs of a wide variety of users. The new field-proven DA2 Earthworks configuration is targeted at small- to mid-size contractors who are ready to take the next step into 3D workflows and take advantage of the efficiency gains that are unlocked by 3D grade control. The new configuration includes the Trimble ProPoint


Ⓡ


positioning engine, which is engineered to provide superior positioning accuracy even in challenging environments. It is available via a Trimble Works subscription, which includes Trimble WorksManager, further lowering upfront costs.


The introduction of the new Trimble Earthworks configuration also enables more customers in more regions to leverage the benefits of the Trimble ecosystem, which streamlines the flow of data between the field and the office and connects project stakeholders with accurate and up-to-date data for better overall decision-making.


“The new Trimble Earthworks configuration provides an exceptional price-to-performance ratio for the machine control market


,” sai


d Cameron Clark, senior director, earthmoving solutions at Trimble. “Other cost-competitive options tend to compromise


on precision and reliability. We know that every minute of downtime or poor performance equals lost revenue for our customers, so we are pleased to announce a full 3D machine control solution available as a subscription that enables cost-sensitive customers to improve productivity and profitability. This means our customers can adopt technology earlier, scale faster and improve productivity across more machines.”


Availability


Trimble Earthworks with DA2 GNSS receivers


will be available in mid-Q4 2026 via


the Trimble dealer network. For more information, contact your local dealer at


[https://civilconstruction.trimble.com/en/how-to-buy/dealer-locator](https://civilconstruction.trimble.com/en/how-to-buy/dealer-locator) .


About Trimble


Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress. For more information about Trimble, visit:


[www.trimble.com](https://www.trimble.com/) .
